words.example: Put a do not disturb sign on the door.
Come in, we can start now.
Please have a seat by the window.
The virtual switch for the server VLAN lost its uplink when the physical NIC died.
words.exampleZh: 物理网卡一坏，服务器 VLAN 的虚拟交换机就失去了上联。

words.example: The uplink NIC on host two is down, and every VM there lost the server VLAN.
words.exampleZh: 二号主机的上联网卡断了，上面每台虚拟机都掉出了服务器 VLAN。

words.example: NIC teaming kept the host online when one physical port on the rack switch died.
words.exampleZh: 机柜交换机有一个物理口坏了，网卡绑定仍让主机保持在线。

words.meaning: 链路聚合（Link Aggregation Control Protocol）
words.example: LACP (Link Aggregation Control Protocol) on the host uplinks needs the matching channel on the switch.
words.exampleZh: 主机上联如果做了 LACP（链路聚合），交换机上必须有对应的通道。

words.example: The load balance across the two uplinks is uneven, and one port is near full.
words.exampleZh: 两条上联之间的负载分担不均，有一个口已经接近打满。
